title: The Lily Pond
summary: Start from what you know (the end) and step back.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Lily pads on a pond double in number every day.
On day 30 the pond is completely covered.
On which day was it half covered?
points: Lily pads on a pond double in number every day.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Start from the end, because the end is the part you know.

steps.title: The method: Work backwards
sentences: If it doubles each day, then one day before it is full, it must be half full.
You do not need any sums.
Just step back one day from the end.
points: If it doubles each day, then one day before it is full, it must be half full.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: The pond was half covered on day 29.
Many people say day 15, because half of 30 is 15, but doubling is not the same as adding the same amount each day.
When growth keeps doubling, the last few days do almost all the work.
points: The pond was half covered on day 29.

quiz.q: A bacteria colony doubles every hour and fills a dish in 12 hours. When is it a quarter full?
quiz.why: Half full at hour 11, a quarter full at hour 10.
